newsitem.title: CANADA: William Resources to issue debentures.
newsitem.headline: William Resources to issue debentures.

text.p: William Resources Inc said on Monday it will issue convertible unsecured subordinated debentures worth C$85 million.

A group of brokerages led by Nesbitt Burns Inc and ScotiaMcLeod Inc have agreed to buy, for resale to the public, subscription receipts exchangealbe for the debentures, the company said in a statement.
The underwriters have the option to purchase for resale up to an additional C$12.75 million of subscription receipts, William Resources said.
The debentures are convertible at the option of the holders and entitle the holders to receive C$1.80 per share prior to maturity.
Proceeds from the debentures will be used to fund a portion of the C$147 million purchase price of the takeover of Terra Mining AB, the company said.
Proceeds will be escrowed pending completion of the takeover.
